title: Retry failed webhooks
subtitle: What the tests prove about three retries, and what they leave open

scenes.narration: Today a webhook that fails once is lost. This change tries again, up to three more times.

steps.say: The waits between tries are one, four and sixteen seconds.
Each try posts the event, and a good answer ends the loop.
Only a server error is worth another try. A bad request, or the last try, gives up.
Otherwise it waits, then tries again.

scenes.title: Delivery tests
scenes.subject: deliver in src/webhooks/deliver.ts
scenes.narration: Four new tests cover the retries. Two old tests change a little, and one is removed.

cases.name: retries a 503 until it succeeds
cases.proves: Two server errors, then success, gives ==delivered== after three calls

cases.name: gives up after three retries
cases.proves: Five server errors stop after **4** calls with failed

cases.name: does not retry a 400
cases.proves: A bad request fails at once, with one call

cases.name: waits 1, 4 and 16 seconds
cases.proves: The waits between tries grow four times each time

cases.name: posts the event as JSON
cases.proves: The body is the event as JSON, now without real waits

cases.name: returns delivered on 200
cases.proves: A good answer on the first try is delivered

cases.name: throws when the receiver errors
cases.proves: A 500 threw an error, which now returns failed instead

gaps: A receiver that never answers, since no try has a time limit
The same event sent twice when a try succeeds but its answer is lost

steps.say: The first two new tests check both ends. A few server errors still end in delivered, and five in a row give up after four calls.
A bad request is never retried, because sending the same thing again would fail the same way.
The fourth test checks the waits themselves, without really waiting.
The test that expected an error is removed, since a failure now returns failed.
Nothing tests a receiver that never answers. Each try waits for it without a limit.
And nothing covers a delivery that worked but whose answer was lost, which sends the event twice.

scenes.title: The delivery tests
scenes.narration: Running the tests shows all six pass, in a few milliseconds, since none really waits.
